description: This source file defines an abstract class 'AsyncTask' used to perform background operations and publish results on the UI thread, with various thread pool configurations, including serial and parallel executors. It includes detailed implementation and usage instructions, catering to Android development environments.

classes.name: AsyncTask
classes.description: Abstract class facilitating background task execution with thread pool management and callback methods for pre-, post-, and progress updates; supports serial and parallel execution modes.

classes.name: AsyncTask.Status
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the current state of the AsyncTask: PENDING, RUNNING, or FINISHED.

classes.name: SerialExecutor
classes.description: Inner class implementing serial execution of runnables, chaining tasks to ensure one executes at a time.

classes.name: InternalHandler
classes.description: Handler class managing messages to post task results and progress updates to the UI thread.

classes.name: WorkerRunnable
classes.description: Inner class implementing Callable, encapsulating parameters and background computation logic.

classes.name: AsyncTaskResult
classes.description: Wrapper class for passing task results and progress updates to handler messages.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Abstract method to perform background computation; must be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: onPreExecute
methods.description: Method called on UI thread before background computation begins; can be overridden for setup.

methods.name: onPostExecute
methods.description: Method called on UI thread after background work completes; receives the result.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Method called on UI thread to update progress, invoked via publishProgress.

methods.name: onCancelled
methods.description: Method invoked on UI thread if task is cancelled.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Starts the task with specified parameters, on the default executor.

methods.name: executeOnExecutor
methods.description: Starts the task on a specified executor, allowing control over threading behavior.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the task execution.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the task has been cancelled.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Waits for task completion and retrieves the result.

methods.name: get(long, TimeUnit)
methods.description: Waits for specified timeout for task completion and retrieves result.
